extension.name: plg_content_feccounts
extension.author: FreeExtraChips Editorial
extension.description:
Resolves {FEC:NAME} placeholders in article bodies with live counts from the FreeExtraChips database (active casinos, bonuses, FXCheck reports, verified slots, active editors).
Enable in Extensions → Plugins after install. Triggers on onContentPrepare so the substitution runs for any article render.
